verdict.rationale: Pendo, a SaaS analytics platform, documents an official MCP server on a dedicated product page that connects AI workflows to usage data, visitor behavior and customer context. It is listed in Claude's official Connectors Directory with no manual configuration needed, and is also positioned for use in ChatGPT and Cursor; a probe confirms the official MCP page. Missing for 10: detailed technical docs on exposed tools, authentication and client setup, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.
